propositions: Backfill close_class for already-closed bugs missing this field using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event indicates regression, plan-review BLOCK indicates plan_defect, gate_error_v1 record indicates env_integration, otherwise undetermined.
Backfilled classifications are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, kept separate from authoritative close_class values in state.
Script is idempotent by ticket_id: skips bugs already present in the backfill artifact and bugs whose state[close_class] is already set (authoritative).
Revert signal must target a substantive event type (STATUS or COMMITS), not metadata events like COMMENT or LINK.
Plan-review BLOCK signal is read via all_review_results and must have verdict==BLOCK; gate_error_v1 signal requires raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files.
Backfilled records carry source==backfill_classified so is_authoritative returns False, segregating them from authoritative structural series.
